    if indent_lvl > max_depth:
        return
    visited = set()
    for mod_name in list(statistics.keys()):
        # 'if mod' excludes root = '', which is never a child
        if (
            mod_name
            and mod_name.count(".") == prefix.count(".")
            and mod_name.startswith(prefix)

                continue
